novel_features.name: One-shot report export
novel_features.description: Export a Power BI or paginated report to PDF/PPTX/PNG/XLSX/CSV/DOCX with a single command — POST, poll, and download handled internally.

novel_features.name: Saved DAX query catalog
novel_features.description: Save named DAX queries to a local catalog and re-run them by name. Parameterize with --var key=value.

novel_features.name: Refresh failure dashboard
novel_features.description: Surface every dataset whose most recent refresh failed in the last N days, with error messages.

novel_features.name: DAX from file with CSV out
novel_features.description: Read a DAX query from a file and emit CSV — pipe-friendly for downstream tooling.

novel_features.name: Auth doctor with tenant settings explainer
novel_features.description: Decode the AAD token, show tenant/app/scopes/expiry, probe /groups, and explain which Power BI tenant setting is blocking you if the probe fails.

novel_features.name: Dataset schema introspection
novel_features.description: Best-effort tables/columns/measures listing for a dataset. Tries INFO.TABLES() DAX (Premium), falls back to dataset metadata.

novel_features.name: Device-code + service-principal login built in
novel_features.description: Interactive device-code flow by default (no Azure CLI needed); service-principal client_credentials flow when --client-secret is passed. Token cached and refreshed.
